editorial.blurb: Lawrence's Fish & Shrimp serves up crispy, generously portioned fried seafood in a casual Southern-style setting where the coconut jumbo shrimp and perfectly fried fish keep customers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the coconut jumbo shrimp with Thai chili sauce and dill pickle fries with jalapeño ranch for takeout to avoid the occasional cleaning-solution smell inside; the food arrives piping hot and sauces are included.
signatureDishes: Coconut jumbo shrimp with Thai chili sauce
Dill pickle fries with jalapeño ranch
